'''Otori Mountain''' (Japanese: '''オオトリ山''' ''Mt. Ōtori'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]] that was featured in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]'' and ''[[XY100|A Festival of Decisions!]]''. It served as the base for a group of ninjas led by [[Kagetomo]]. It is located between [[Anistar City]] and [[Couriway Town]].

After kidnapping {{kal|Hanzo}}, Kagetomo, [[Heidayu]], and their ninja army fled to Otori Mountain where Kagetomo announced his plans of attempting to succeed Hanzo as the chief of the [[Ninja Village]] instead of [[Ippei]]. While {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, [[Shinobu]], and the ninjas of the village took on Kagetomo's ninja army, Ippei and [[Saizo]] went to Otori Mountain to rescue Hanzo. Arriving there, Ippei had a battle with Kagetomo and emerged victorious. Ash's group met up with Ippei and Saizo after they defeated the ninja army.
